review-the-no-pin-investigation.text: As an integrator, I want to reproduce the candidate checks and understand exactly what they establish.

current-status.text: Only the investigation planning package exists at this checkpoint. No new model guarantee, proof, simulator result or ledger behavior is claimed.
Read spec.md for the promised decision surface.
Read authority.md for the exact baseline and unresolved dependencies.
Follow tasks.md for the evidence stages and plan.md for the verification fence.
At a frozen model candidate, run nix run .#model-check.
For the corresponding changed consumer, run nix develop --quiet -c just application-model; for generated model/simulator changes run nix develop --quiet -c just simulator.
Read the candidate's impact/decision records and independent audit before interpreting any green result as satisfying an obligation.
The final handoff must record actual command exits and candidate hashes. These commands describe the planned verification path; they have not been run for a new model in this planning phase.
